class UnnamedSectionDisabledError(Error):
    """Raised when the unnamed section is used while the feature is disabled.

    This occurs when explicitly adding the UNNAMED_SECTION sentinel as a
    section on a parser constructed without ``allow_unnamed_section=True``.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        Error.__init__(self, 'Unnamed section is not enabled')
        self.args = ()
